steps.note: the API built this case's state
Use an RFQ pricing stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product row needed for the vendor price field.
Complete the buyer pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will use the vendor portal.
Move to the vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the published RFQ's vendor pricing sheet.
Enter the invalid letters into the vendor's Price field.
Verify the invalid letters are not retained visibly on the vendor screen.
Attempt submission and require the portal to refuse the invalid price.
